description: Pre-trade safety screen for an ERC-20 on Base — the 'is this safe to buy/approve BEFORE I sign' check. Verifies you can actually SELL it back (honeypot detection), measures the real round-trip cost (buy+sell fees/tax), and reports whether ownership is renounced (a live owner can often change taxes, pause, or mint). Returns a single risk verdict. On-chain only; no oracle, no trust in the token's own claims.
name: token_safety_screen
